_comment_encoding: Output is dimmer2048 (binary, 0x000-0x800), not the dimmer800 (BCD 0-800) the file name says: the Spartan-7 bitstream multiplies register 0x35 as plain binary and has never decoded BCD, so BCD made the backlight a staircase with ~5.5 % jumps at every BCD hundreds boundary (12.5, 25, ... 100 %). Measured 2026-10-11: binary is linear, ~12 nits per 1 %. The file keeps its name because micropanel's pi-config-txt links it by name.
_comment_variant: 14.6-inch FHD scan-mode EJ panel (pi-config-txt type 14.6-fhd-ej). Same Spartan-7 board, OPT4001 and dimmer800 output as config_fpga_opti4001_lux_dimmer800.json (14.6-fhd direct-drive and 12.3-NQ5); only the brightness-to-nits curve differs, so only sweep_table does. calibrations/dimmer800_14_6_ej.csv is a REFERENCE (golden-sample) sweep of one EJ unit, 2026-10-11: 1074 nits at 100 % against the shared table's 1187.

local_dimming_profiles._comment: Day/night local dimming (pixelpipe-fpga docs/dynamic-local-dimming.md §18; 14.6-inch EJ scan from FPGA v0x6E). The detected zone selects raw FPGA 0x1E page-0 registers: ld_alpha 0x31 (LD max/avg blend, 16 = baked default; higher = small content brighter, more halo), pc_tune 0x33 (pixel-compensation gain/64, 64 = 1.0x; from the FPGA's linear-domain PC (0x4C = 1, docs §19) it multiplies the restored light: 64 = the LD-off luminance of greys, 83 = +30 % for daylight readability, white unchanged), bl_boost 0x49 (low-APL boost on the LED gain, 64 = off, 90 = up to 1.4x; from FPGA v0x77-79 the linear-domain PC divides it out per frame (B_ref/B, docs §20): the boost adds backlight headroom, i.e. less pixel lift and fewer clipped highlights in dark zones at more LED power, not brightness; content brightness is pc_tune), led_gain 0x43, bl_rise 0x4A. Same profile values as the 12.3-inch NQ5: bl_boost stays 64 in every zone (no panel rating yet; the power-up cap 0x7F80 = LD-off white never binds on LD-on content, so a boost would raise full white too, cf. review v4 N17). A zone must hold min_dwell_sec before its profile is used; static_profile applies when the user switches dynamic LD off.
local_dimming_profiles._comment_led_gain: LED gain 0x43 per zone, Fable prompt v12 (2026-10-17): the 12.3-inch recipe, 160 / 160 / 180 / 205 (static / night / indoor / outdoor; was the seed 128 everywhere). At 128 white is backlight-limited (~0.65 of LD off on a ramp) below the compensated 222 bar, so the top of a grey ramp inverted; greys are unchanged (the FPGA divides the gain out of the lift, B_ref/B). Measured on v0x88 (i1, full white): the LED words saturate in the driver (DRIVE_GAIN 170/128 after B) from gain ~170 at GD 100 % (white 1049 / 1228 / 1272 / 1272 cd/m2 at 128 / 160 / 180 / 205), so the day gains add white only below ~85 % GD; the cap 0x7F80 does not bind (B readback follows the gain).
local_dimming_profiles._comment_nits_gain: The nits table (calibrations/dimmer800_14_6_ej.csv) was swept at led_gain 128. Full white at gain g reads (g/128)^e brighter: measured 2026-10-17 (FPGA v0x88) at GD 50 / 25 %: 160 -> e 0.94 / 0.99, 180 -> 0.92 / 0.93, 205 -> 0.92 / 0.93 (the 12.3-inch value 0.92). At GD 100 % the driver clips from gain ~170 (see _comment_led_gain): the API over-states white there by up to 27 % at gain 205.

thermal_compensation._comment: Only the temperature source is used here (no factor table): the thermal_limit below reads the backlight temperature from the display IOC (0x66, register 0x1002, int16 x 0.1 C).

thermal_limit._comment: Keeps the backlight at about start_c (proportional): limit = 100 - gain_percent_per_c x (T - start_c), floor min_percent, at most step_percent per 10 s reading; LD boost off while T >= start_c. No reading = no limiting. Temperature from the display IOC (0x66, register 0x1002). 14.6-inch EJ scan: 39 C idle on the bench (2026-10-15); start_c 60 as on the other panels pending the panel's derating spec and a soak measurement.
